Glowing Moths are small, collectible moths found throughout Harandar. They are marked on the minimap with a . There are 120 of them in total. Each moth collected grants Luminous Dust, which can be traded to Mothkeeper Wew'tam for various rewards. Additionally, the first collected moth will give a Small Pile of Luminous Dust, starting the quest Where Dust Dances. Collecting all 120 moths grants the achievement Dust 'Em Off.
Glowing Moth Dust is obtained by collecting any Glowing Moth that was already collected by another character in the same warband.

The Goaz Stone is a large tablet discovered by Prospector Whelgar at his excavation site in the Wetlands. It is written in Titan script, and speaks of a "divine plan" and a "doomed prophecy" related to the Old Gods. The Stone lacked four fragments (Ados, Modr, Golm, and Neru) but was able to be fully reconstituted. In , the Goaz Scrolls can be found at the excavation site as well.

Goldie Baronbottom is a Venture Company goblin located in the Cinderbrew Meadery. She seized control of the meadery after it was damaged shortly in a battle against nerubians and Wenbrandt, the owner, grew impatient waiting for the repairs and accepted an offer from the Venture Company to "restructure" it. Once she became the "BEE.E.O." she ordered her employees to start caging the cinderbees and diluting the cinderbrew in an attempt to increase productivity at the cost of the brew's quality and the bees' well-being. Wenbrandt eventually enlisted adventurers in reclaiming his meadery from Goldie and her goons.

Goldengill Trout is an fish that can be caught in Khaz Algar. They are most commonly fished from Glimmerpools, though they can be caught in open water, particularly in Azj-Kahet. When one of these fish is caught, the player receives a fifteen minute buff called Goldengill Blessing that increases Perception by 45. This Perception increase includes all professions, and is an incredibly useful buff. These fish are also used in the production of fresh fillets for Cooking.
